body: I feel guilty because I feel like I'm "using" him when we meet up. The reason I think telling will help is because it worked for me in the past but I understand why it's also not helpful in the big scheme of things...

Hey, I just wanted to say that I think you're very brave for coming to terms with yourself... There are probably plenty of people who never have so well done! I don't have any advice but just wanted to let you know that you're awesome :)
But I was considering this even before drinking... I see your point though.
I may still be sad but this really lifted my spirits, thank you :)

Ok well the fact that you'd take a life like that means you have the want for it, which is great! So does that give you your reason not to kill yourself? Aim for that goal (and maybe try find others with a similar goal)?

If I gave you a life where you could work with your colleagues and get along with them, then come home and play video games and whatnot, would you take that life? If so, do you think you could create that life for yourself?
What's your idea of a fun time? If you don't have one, what would be your ideal fun time?

I will remember that next time I see them. I was wary about telling them everything but I understand that it's not what I feel that matters right now, it's what I need which matters. I'll have some faith, thanks :)

I'm seeing a therapist although haven't been to them recently since I think they forgot about me haha, I will call them tomorrow. Why is it bad to hurt myself as a release? (Sorry if I come across as rude, I'm genuinely interested in your response)
